claims.text: Production and release evaluation use the same non-streaming AnswerPipelineService path.
Canonical ingestion validates and atomically publishes PDF, AST, page, chunk, figure, metadata, SQLite, and manifest artifacts.
Strict-local analysis rejects public acquisition branches and permits prepared files plus loopback model services.
Selective repair performs deterministic text mutation and a second verification pass.
Retrospective retrieval: BM25+dense has an uncertain Hit@1 gain over BM25, while modality boosting harms first-page ranking.
Paired repair raises automatic overlap while lowering cited-page alignment on the answerable cases.
The pipeline ABSTAINED status declines in cross-paper controls after repair; semantic refusal is unjudged.
Local operational timings are measured on one 18 GB M3 Pro without peak RSS or controlled cache profiling.
A completed 150-case LLM-based evaluation records 59 correct, 33 partly correct, 20 incorrect, and 38 not-judgeable correctness labels; only 113 cases passed the reference-eligibility gate.

The 150-case LLM-based evaluation is not attributed to a named judge model in the manuscript, and its visual-grounding distribution is excluded because retained model identity and visual-rubric values do not match the planning protocol.
The prepared human study assigns 50 questions to five evaluators for 250 planned ratings, but contained zero submitted ratings across zero cases at the September 21, 2026 manuscript freeze.
